## Summary

Ramon builds developer infrastructure and takes it to market. Engineer by training, 20+ years in software, the last 10 in developer tools. He has led product, engineering and go-to-market teams, and founded two companies. Languages: Catalan and Spanish (native), English and French (professional), Italian (basic).
